As Alexa Audio, we own the audio experiences on Alexa enabled devices. These experiences include Music, Podcast, Audio Books, Radio, and Ambient soundscapes. 6\. Mentor junior members of the team and help them onboard. They participate in interviews and hiring efforts for the team, and constantly share knowledge of components they own and have expert knowledge of through mediums such as demos, lunch\-n\-learns, and org\-wide emails.  

  

7\. Leadership principles that are most important for this role are ownership, deliver results, deep dive, bias for action, hire \& develop the best, and earns trust.

We collaborate across disciplines. You will have the opportunity to work closely with product managers, UX designers and researchers, and business intelligence engineers to innovate, measure, analyze and refine the experiences we deliver to millions of customers across the planet on a daily basis. description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.


The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.


The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.

* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.

title: Software Engineer III
description:
**About Team:**

RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.


**About the role:**

A Software Engineer III is an individual contributor who delivers production\-quality software for well\-defined components or features within a product or service. They work with guidance from senior engineers to translate requirements into maintainable, secure, and reliable systems that support customer and business outcomes. They are developing deeper knowledge of the systems within their team and contribute to engineering quality, operational health, and team collaboration while continuing to build their technical expertise.


**Requirements:**

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Typically 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and contribute to production software systems
* Experience working in Agile cross\-functional product development teams
* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions
* Proficiency in one modern backend stack (.NET/C\# essential, Java or Node.js) plus familiarity with SQL/data skills
* Understanding of system design and domain modelling (SOLID, design patterns, API design)
* Experience writing unit/integration tests and CI/CD experience
* Cloud and DevOps exposure (preferably AWS), including observability and operational readiness
* Security\-minded approach aligned to Secure SDLC practices

**Responsibilities**

**Technical Excellence**

* Produces clear technical documentation using the process for technical decision making and RX architectural principles.
* Builds software with foundations in performance, resilience, extensibility, and security following the Secure SDLC
* Applies testing strategies that support deployment confidence and align with the Service \& Operational Level Agreements
* Contributes to incremental improvements to code quality, testing, or development workflows.
* Writes clean, maintainable code and participates actively in peer code reviews
* Learns and applies team standards, design patterns, and engineering practices.
* Solves well\-defined technical problems with support from more experienced engineers.
* Shares knowledge and learns from peers within the team.

**Operational Excellence**

* Supports the operational health of services and components within their team.
* Uses logs, monitoring, and metrics to help diagnose issues.
* Builds systems with operational considerations in mind, including reliability and recoverability.
* Participates in incident response and post\-incident reviews with guidance.
* Maintains runbooks, documentation, and operational knowledge for owned components.
* Contributes to reducing technical debt and improving maintainability in assigned areas.
* Ensures dependencies and security updates are applied to owned systems.
* Operational knowledge and awareness improve over time through hands\-on experience.

**Product Delivery \& Business Impact**

* Implements well\-defined requirements into working software features.
* Works with senior engineers to break down tasks and deliver incremental improvements.
* Delivers high\-quality software with predictable cycle times and low change failure rates under guidance.
* Collaborates with Product and Engineering to ensure solutions align with user and business outcomes.
* Raises delivery risks early and seeks guidance to resolve them.
* Contributes to simplifying implementation and improving code maintainability.
* Contributions support team delivery goals and product reliability

**Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Takes ownership of components or small features within a product or platform team.
* Communicates progress and technical topics clearly within the team.
* Seeks feedback and incorporates guidance from senior engineers and technical leads.
* Builds strong working relationships within the team and with close cross\-team partners.
* Demonstrates accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
* Begins mentoring more junior engineers or new team members where appropriate.

You’ll play a key role in shaping robust, scalable platforms while influencing how technology is built at scale, engineering standards and delivery outcomes—working on systems that have measurable impact at scale. If you’re excited by leading product teams, shaping technology, and delivering software that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

The overall objective of this role is to assist in applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Utilize knowledge of applications development procedures and concepts, and basic knowledge of other technical areas to identify and define necessary system enhancements
* Conduct testing and debugging, utilize script tools, and write basic code

* Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

	+ Exposure to an industry\-standard database (Oracle) on a UNIX platform with awareness of database design and SQL scripting knowledge and performance tuning
	+ Awareness of unit testing frameworks like JUnit or TestNG
	+ Awareness of application servers /webservers
	+ Work experience on the transactional applications for low latency, high availability uses is a plus
